caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a round, slightly irregular tabletop featuring visible grain and plank lines. The tabletop is medium to dark brown in color, with some lighter highlights suggesting reflections or wear. The table stands on a turned central pedestal that transitions into three gracefully curved legs extending outward at the base, each leg ending in a simple, footed form. The pedestal and legs are also brown, matching the tone of the tabletop. The entire table is set against a plain, light beige or off-white background, with no additional objects or patterns present. The artist's signature, "Carl Buergemiss," appears in small writing near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Candle Table
